title: File:Religious Graffiti - Uliastai, Zavkhan, Mongolia.jpg
desc: Religious graffiti at the base of Togs Boyant Javklhant Monastery in Uliastai, Zavkhan, Mongolia. Transliterated from Mongolian cyrillic, "Ommani Badme Xom," this is the traditional six-syllable mantra associated with the bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara.
